# Comp near Salmalh. Va

Horad queline Sen, Sturges (9) lin

Dec. ath 1862.

Doer friends

Mr. Wells

- parkerel, to sent a line ly him lo you. caches deilly when sent frem the Army We reached aquia Greek safely evi the line anticipated and to in great you

vapt (maj) dead of the 211t was B. master

as son as the Beat was unloaded he came on board and sofint the remainder of the every with me, we had a hume chat 2 auer you

- reaine lill the next day, sent a lil i affles ete up to the Captis quarters, ance juvedi with the remarides of on luggage for which, it is needles to say read Cosefoldin
